meta.notes: B2B/B2C subscription software benchmarks. Correlations the generator must respect: churn falls with ARPA/ACV; GRR rises with ACV; CAC payback rises with ACV; NRR = GRR + expansion; deferred revenue scales with annual-prepay share; LTV/CAC is arithmetic of ARPA, gross margin, churn and CAC, never sampled independently of them.
meta.percentile_semantics: p10..p90 are cross-sectional percentiles of companies (or shipments/plants where noted), not time-series percentiles. 'distribution' is the recommended family for sampling between the anchors; 'empirical' means piecewise-linear quantile interpolation across p10..p90 with tails clamped.
